title: Polyline
statementMd:
There are three points marked on the coordinate plane. The goal is to make a simple polyline, without self-intersections and self-touches, such that it passes through all these points. Also, the polyline must consist of only segments parallel to the coordinate axes. You are to find the minimum number of segments this polyline may consist of.

## Input

Each of the three lines of the input contains two integers. The $*i*$-th line contains integers $*x*_{*i*}$ and $*y*_{*i*}$ ($- 10^{9} ≤ *x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$) — the coordinates of the $*i*$-th point. It is guaranteed that all points are distinct.

## Output

Print a single number — the minimum possible number of segments of the polyline.

## Note

The variant of the polyline in the first sample: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c70160ef7d7b1362a5f92f9d065683227130b29c.png) The variant of the polyline in the second sample: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e0f86bc45363eca26599d58a662f130f7bc3c006.png) The variant of the polyline in the third sample: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8730eb428cbf60a6526ce5a8a89320b260e52504.png)
statementZhMd:
坐标平面上标记了三个点。目标是构造一条经过这三个点的简单折线，且折线不能自交或自接触。此外，折线只能由平行于坐标轴的线段组成。请找出这条折线可能包含的最少线段数。

## 输入格式

输入包含三行，每行包含两个整数。第 $*i*$ 行包含整数 $*x*_{*i*}$ 和 $*y*_{*i*}$（$- 10^{9} ≤ *x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$）——第 $*i*$ 个点的坐标。保证所有点互不相同。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——折线可能包含的最少线段数。

## 说明
